recentItems.title: What it's like to spend the night in a nuclear bunker in Finland
recentItems.description:
Inside, in what is normally a sports hall, hundreds of people in the central Finnish city of Kuopio are sleeping overnight on trestle beds.

More than 2,000 people including volunteers and students are taking part in the biggest civil defense exercise in Europe since the end of World War II.

recentItems.description:
